evals.prompt:
Route the following independent Unity requests using the supplied unity-cli skill. Do not execute Unity, call tools, or claim that any state changed. Return JSON only as {"results":[...]}, with one result per case in input order. A protocol result has id, kind="protocol", commandId as one canonical slash ID, args, and tier.
